content: FastMCP server: pip install fastmcp. Create: mcp = FastMCP('ServerName'). Register tools: @mcp.tool decorator on functions with type hints. Docstrings become tool descriptions. Run: mcp.run() for stdio transport. Current version 2.14.7 requires mcp>=1.24,<2 (compatible with google-adk[mcp]). Alternative: fastmcp 3.x available but 2.x is more stable and tested. gofastmcp.com is official docs.
